questions.q: What early advantage helped Rockefeller lower oil transport costs?
a: A rebate deal with Lake Shore Railroad
questions.why: The Lake Shore deal gave him a $1.65 per barrel rate.

questions.q: When was Standard Oil declared an illegal monopoly?
questions.why: The Supreme Court ruled the monopoly illegal on that date.

questions.q: How did Rockefeller respond to the breakup of his company?
a: He started a new oil firm
questions.why: He used the time and wealth to expand charitable work.

questions.q: What childhood circumstance contributed to Rockefeller's early entrepreneurship?
questions.why: Father's absences gave John opportunities to pursue business.

questions.q: What was the primary purpose of the Rockefeller Foundation?
questions.why: He founded it to build a charitable trust bigger than any before.
